text:
Maria G: quick q on tool/function-call streaming in chat completions — are we guaranteed to emit an explicit end event for a tool call (e.g. `tool_call.end` or `tool_end`) or should clients expect the final function payload to arrive only as the last delta with no separate marker? I ran into a client that waits for an explicit end marker and it broke with a streaming test.

Devin K: current contract we have in prod is: start event, a series of deltas, then an end event with metadata + final payload. example: ```json
{
  "event": "tool_call.start",
  "tool": "search"
}
... (deltas) ...
{
  "event": "tool_call.end",
  "tool": "search",
  "result": { ... }
}
```
Clients that rely on `tool_call.end` will break if we remove it. We discussed making the end marker optional for low-latency streaming, but that requires an explicit opt-in.

Leo T: is the opt-in flag `toolcall_streaming_v2` feasible? If we can't add a new event type I'd prefer adding an explicit `final_chunk: true` boolean on the last delta so clients can detect termination without a separate event. That keeps backward compat (no change unless client opts into v2) and lets streaming-first clients avoid a separate control frame.

Rachel S: +1 to either a versioned opt-in or adding `final_chunk` as a nullable field. If we add `final_chunk` we need to ensure SDKs parse it (small patch) — should we ship this as a minor (no client break) or a semver-major? My read: `final_chunk` is backwards-compatible: old clients just ignore the field. So minor. Removing `tool_call.end` entirely would be a breaking change and needs a major + migration plan.

Maria G: ok — action items: 1) add `final_chunk: boolean` to streaming delta schema as optional, 2) add an opt-in header `x-rw-toolcall-stream-v2` for early adopters if they want explicit removal of `tool_call.end`, 3) update SDKs to react to `final_chunk` (small patch). Anyone object?

Devin K: no objections. I'll draft a tiny schema PR + changelog. I'll include compatibility tests: replay old recorded streams and new ones to verify both client types behave.

Leo T: I'll add an integration test that simulates interleaved toolcall deltas + convo messages (we had a flaky case where toolcall deltas interleave with assistant text and end markers clashed). Plan to run it in staging canary.

Maria G: @Rachel S can you confirm whether console dashboards need any change for the new `final_chunk` flag (for tracing/alerts)?

Rachel S: should be fine — we'll just index the field and make a small UI filter. I can do that after the API PR lands. No dashboard schema migrations needed.

Maria G: cool. I'll open the change-proposal PR and tag the SDK owners. ETA: PR by EOD.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/canary/1757777000-1 — will run integration tests against staging for the toolcall streaming changes.

Devin K: assigned the PR to @Leo T and @Rachel S for quick review, will add test matrix.

Leo T: sg, will review this afternoon.

Rachel S: ack, will prioritize SDK changes after PR merges.

Maria G: thanks all :+1:
